name: Turkey
overview:
Let’s get one thing out of the way first: BYZANTIUM CONSTANTINOPLE ISTANBUL IS THE GREATEST CITY ON EARTH. Okay, moving on.

But seriously, has there been a city more consequential through human history? Your LLM of choice might suggest Rome, but Istanbul was the capital of the Roman Empire was twice as long as Rome itself! 

With a cultural identity that straddles east and west, Turkey offers an experience unlike any place else. The magnificent mosques and astounding Ottoman architecture are worth the visit alone!
